# ST558 HW 9
## Stanley Xiao

### First we load the dataset

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(rsample)

bike_raw <- read_csv(
  "https://www4.stat.ncsu.edu/~online/datasets/SeoulBikeData.csv", 
  locale = locale(encoding = "latin1"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

glimpse(bike_raw)
```

### EDA

```{r}
# Check for missing values; there are no missing values
colSums(is.na(bike_raw))
```

### Data Cleaning & Transformations

```{r}
bike_clean <- bike_raw |>
  rename(
    date = Date,
    bike_count = `Rented Bike Count`,
    hour = Hour,
    temp = `Temperature(°C)`,
    humidity = `Humidity(%)`,
    wind_speed = `Wind speed (m/s)`,
    visibility = `Visibility (10m)`,
    dew_point_temp = `Dew point temperature(°C)`,
    solar_radiation = `Solar Radiation (MJ/m2)`,
    rainfall = `Rainfall(mm)`,
    snowfall = `Snowfall (cm)`,
    seasons = Seasons,
    holiday = Holiday,
    functioning_day = `Functioning Day`
  ) |>
  mutate(
    data = dmy(date),
    seasons = factor(seasons),
    holiday = factor(holiday),
    functioning_day = factor(functioning_day)
  )

str(bike_clean)
```

### Functioning Day Inspection & Subsetting

```{r}
bike_clean |>
  group_by(functioning_day) |>
  summarise(
    count_obs = n(),
    mean_rentals = mean(bike_count),
    min_rentals = min(bike_count),
    max_rentals = max(bike_count)
  )

bike_functional <- bike_clean |>
  filter(functioning_day == "Yes")

bike_daily <- bike_functional |>
  group_by(date,seasons, holiday) |>
  summarise(
    bike_count = sum(bike_count),
    rainfall = sum(rainfall),
    snowfall = sum(snowfall),
    across(
      c(temp, humidity, wind_speed, visibility, dew_point_temp, solar_radiation),
      mean,
      .names = "{.col}"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

### Hourly to Daily Aggregation

```{r}
# Group by date, seasons, and holiday, calculate sum of bike_count, rain and snowfall, calculate means of temp, humidity, wind_speed, visibility, dew_point_temp, and solar_radiation

bike_daily <- bike_functional |>
  group_by(date, seasons, holiday) |>
  summarise(
   bike_count = sum(bike_count),
   rainfall = sum(rainfall),
   snowfall = sum(snowfall),
   across(
     c(temp, humidity, wind_speed, visibility, dew_point_temp, solar_radiation),
     mean,
     .names = "{.col}"
   ),
   .groups = "drop"
  )
```

### Summary Statistics & Graphical Summaries

```{r}
bike_daily |>
  group_by(seasons, holiday) |>
  summarise(
    n_days = n(),
    mean_bikes = mean(bike_count),
    sd_bikes = sd(bike_count),
    mean_bikes = median(bike_count),
    IQR_bikes = IQR(bike_count),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

### Distribution & Relationships

```{r}
# Daily bike rentals by season
ggplot(bike_daily, aes(x = seasons, y = bike_count, fill = seasons)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, show.legend = FALSE) + 
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Daily Bike Rental Counts Across Seasons",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Total Daily Rentals"
  )

# Bike rentals vs temperature colored by season
ggplot(bike_daily, aes(x = temp, y = bike_count, fill = seasons)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Daily Bike Rentals vs Average Daily Temperature",
    x = "Temperature (°C)",
    y = "Total Daily Rentals"
  )
```


### Numeric Correlations

```{r}
numeric_vars <- bike_daily |>
  select(bike_count, rainfall, snowfall, temp, humidity, wind_speed, visibility, dew_point_temp, solar_radiation)

# Correlation matrix
cor_matrix <- round(cor(numeric_vars), 3)
cor_matrix
```

### Data Splitting

```{r}
set.seed(558)
daily_split <- initial_split(bike_daily, prop = 0.75, strata = seasons)
train_raw <- training(daily_split)
test_raw <- testing(daily_split)

# Verify split proportions and stratafication
table(train_raw$seasons) / nrow(train_raw)
table(test_raw$seasons) / nrow(test_raw)
```
